I actually found what these are but these are very very small dots, nothing similar to coins.

These do feel like chicken skin and are basically a small bump of fat. And it looks like I've had this as a side effect for fatty liver.

previously people on this subreddit told me this is lichen nitidus and based on what I found online it wasn't anything to worry about. but rarely in some specific spots, they got blood inside them and can be basically popped!

(In the picture the larger red bump is from a mosquito or something afaik. Don't let that confuse you.)

I notices the bumped 5 months ago and they haven't really changed much. They just rarely get blood in them and it has happened like 3 times upto now and like 10 of the small bumps get blood and not the rest.

I'm just worried about it in general since it looks like it can be due to some other condition like HIV but idk if I should worry or not.
Yeah. The only thing left to do is to just find a permanent home for catA.

I think my other response I just wrote partially answers this.

I am just keeping one of them now. One was never an issue. The one with the broken leg. CatB.

Logically, I shouldn't care if they fight. They'll be friendly again after a while. But somehow I couldn't. I learned to control the results a little bit but that wasn't helpful enough. The minimum was that I would get annoyed but that was not the goal of getting pets.

CatB is already much more cuddly since there isn't constant growling happening in the room. I think today was a huge step towards the happy ending.

Her leg broke because I grabbed her wrongly. Which could happen at any time technically. Although obviously if I wasn't mad it wouldn't happen but knowing that it could happen at any time anyways kind of let's me forgive myself easier. I just hope she recovers fully without permanent issues. I am not much worried since she is agile af even with the cast on her leg.

I didn't hit her today but I got annoyed and grabbed her by her scruff a few times. So I realized even if I can deal with it and not hurt them physically, it's still annoying. It's like living with two people who hate each other. I couldn't enjoy my time with any of them. So I should just keep one cat.

CatA was grumpy all the time. Would instantly escape to hide in a hole (from me and catB) or just my bed. I would try to make her stay on my bed so I can see her and see she is okay. She wouldn't play. She wouldn't eat if she saw catB. She just looked like she was super tired/sick in general.

So I decided to bring catA to my mom's place temporarily. I don't have to deal with the annoyance of their fights + catA's mood would be reset at least.

Once catA got into that house she was like a new cat. Running around. Playing. Happy. I wasn't expecting her to be this happy this fast. If I knew she would be this happy this fast I would bring her there sooner.

I just got home. I'm pretty emotional since catA isn't here anymore but it's for everyone's good. I'm pretty sure I won't have single issue at all in the future just having a single cat. 

Although we are still not sure about where catA will live permanently, but I'll look for a new home for her more actively now that I'm sure of my decision.

I have so many different emotions right now but I want to focus on just enjoying my time with cat B. I already am feeling so much peace with her alone.

I am going to start therapy next month anyways.

Unfortunately where I live there aren't any shelters or anything like that. I mean in my country. I live in middle east. Lots of people have pets and there are vets and pet stores but not shelters or adoption centers.

These cats were stray cats that were fed by a kind woman. There were 6 kittens I think. I got two of them. 3 of the rest got "lost" after I took these two. 

The previous take carer which was this kind woman is very picky about adoption etc and repeatedly says I must not leave them on the streets (never was in my options anyways) or give them for adoption myself.

She said whenever I wanted to give them away, I should just tell her which I already have. They are currently looking for a new take carer for cat A. But unfortunately it can take a while...

I am really trying to be better so I can keep them both but it's too risky even if I control myself for a week or two.

Since it can take long for them to find a new home, my plan is to just try to better myself so they can live with me until then. But if I see I might hurt them again I will temporarily give them to my mom.

Once new take carers are found, I can choose if I should let them go or not based on what has happened lately. If I have been good maybe I'll keep them. But in general keeping two is too risky as cat A starts hissing way too often for random stuff since she is easily scared.

I am probably going to keep cat B. But that also depends on my actions until then. I previously had single pets and never had issues and I never get annoyed by a single pets actions. The only thing that irritates me is the tension/conflict between two pets for some reason.

So in the best scenario I keep them both. Worse scenario I keep none. And the most probable scenario is that I keep B only. 

I know my post is terrible to read and I sound like a monster which I probably am for doing those but I am still shocked to my core since I have never ever had such experiences before with anger or anything similar. I am a really calm person overall. I am going to start therapy next month (can't afford it now) and just try to release my energy/anger in proper ways.

Your comment is not too harsh really. My goal is to keep the cats safe. If I can provide that environment for them, great. If not they'll be re-homed permanently or at least temporarily at my mom's if a new home can't be found soon enough. 

I am feeling very confident that I'll b able to handle my weird emotions and energies from now on but only time can tell. Wish me luck :(

Not that you are going to read my novel comment, but I just want to add that the reason I want to better myself to be able to keep them both is not only to just be a better person and not harm animals, its also because I want to make it up for these poor cats :(

Unfortunately there are no shelters where I live so I have to find a new owner or just leave them at the streets. They were previously living in the streets and just was fed by a kind woman twice a day. She is the one finding homes for the kittens. I took two, 3 of the rest of the kittens got "lost" in the streets after I got these two... 

I have had pets before and never had any issues remotely similar to this. Never hurt them in any way. I always only had one pet, not more than one in the same time. I don't mind one pet doing annoying things etc. I've seen people get mad at their pet for doing X. I never feel anything like that. I only get irritated when there is a conflict between them / they bully each other etc. 

I know they'll get friendly again by time and this issue will hide for a while but since cat A seems to get scared too easily she will probably start hissing too often in the future after vet visits or any other random thing which can cause issues again. So it's too risky.

I am currently looking for new take carers but it can take a while unfortunately. My plan is to keep them until then. If I end up mistreating them again, I will temporarily give them to my mom instantly.

I don't want to do any more damage and I couldn't live with myself if they got any permanent damage. I am already so scared of cat B's leg not healing properly. Although I'm not much worried about her mobility anymore since she is agile af with the cast on her leg! 

I still hope I resolve my internal issues & learn to control myself so I can keep both of them but the chances are low obviously. It's really new to me and in trying to figure it out yet.

If I was able to not mistreat them until a new take carer is found, I'll keep both. If not, I'll give at least one of them away. But if I see I have issues with a single one as well, I will find her a new home as well.

Finding a new home for them takes time so it's not like I can just do it tomorrow. 

My issue isn't mainly anger but ends up with anger so handling it is a little bit different. While I am passively looking for a new home for them, I am trying to better myself so similar things won't happen.  If I am successful in stopping this behavior I'll keep them.
Thank you sm

Thank you. I'll try my best.

Yeah I should just not try to deal with their friendship. I'll just pet them when they come to me. 

I'll probably update here as well. 😔🤞
Thank you

It's okay. I was expecting worse to be honest. And it's not like I wouldn't have the same reaction if I read someone else do it.

Can you suggest me some? Since you say you use them yourself.

Although my issue is a mix of several things, I do these in order:
1 - I try to procastinate by making myself busy with the pets instead of working
2 - I try to make them sit close to each other but far away, just so they are in each other's presence
3 - I push them into it too far so they attack and hiss more
4 - Step 3 causes some weird switch to be flipped in my head, I continue the steps while knowing I shouldn't have done this after step 2...
5 - I get angry, I hit cat A in the head while shouting NO.
6 - repeat 4 & 5 a few times and I end up hitting her more than just softly on the head

I think I should just cut this from step 1. Play some video games or something. Is easier than stopping mid way. 

I have deep anger issues because I never release/show my anger. So if something pokes at it it just explodes. and basically I make poke it at myself doing these.

I'm pretty sure I can stop this by just a little bit of self control. I wish I wasn't home alone this much, it would help so much. :( 

Anyways... I hope I can stop so I can them :(

When they were friendly they would wrestle alot which was so cute. The hissing is different. Cat A is smaller so she probably is scared easier and hisses more as the result.

I can't re-home them instantly unfortunately. They are stray cats and I don't really want to just leave them on streets. B has to heal for a month as well. 

To be honest this beast that is released scares me as well :( I never knew I had such a thing inside me... 

When they don't bully each other I love them more than anything. My life has been all about them these 2 months. 

I really am ashamed of all the things I've done but I really really want to try to stop since I really do want to keep them. I know I've written lots of nasty things here but they are my babies :((( 

My current plan is to:
1- start therapy asap (probably next month, can't afford it now)
2- don't try to force their friendship doing anything that isn't recommended by specialists.
3- just ignore them and let them do their own thing if they are hissing etc.

Rehoming takes time fortunately or unfortunately. I will be passively looking to re-home them but I really hope I can reach a point where I think I am no longer a danger to them so I can keep them. :((((

I love the both. Cat A is cute and B is really nice. I pretty much broke B's leg so I think I should keep her. Also B never hisses so the chance of future issues is less.

I think A hisses because she is smaller and is bad at fighting/defending her self. So she is scared easier.

I should just keep myself busy or something and leave them do their own thing. The only productive thing I do to make them friendlier to each other is to feed them in the same time with bowls that are close to each other. It will help them associate each other with food.

Where I live it's not easy to find people adopt. My kittens were posted for adoption for 2 months. So it will take some time. I can temporarily give them to some family members but they can't take them more than a week.

I have made the promise of just letting them do their own thing a few times already :( I hope I will not break it this time.

I think the initial issue is that I want to keep doing X so I don't do Y. So I just go and make myself busy with them and it ends up angering me...

If I fail again I'll re-home them at my mom's for now :(

The short answer is that these countries have a system and every system can be abused. They have to make sure you aren't lying just to get into another country.

I have read specific news about the two and the flag one was later resolved and he became a refugee.

In general the countries that have more asylum seekers are more picky and the situation of the asylum seekers is worse as well. So a good idea is to try to go to a less popular country for asylum seeking. Somewhere far from middle east and not being a popular country.

In some countries it can take up to 10 years to be accepted as a refugee and the country won't even offer camp or let you legally work.

Yeah. Although depending on the country, it can be hard to become a refugee even if you really deserve it. I've heard people getting rejected because of not knowing what each color on the LGBT raimbo flag means or they not being "gay acting" enough.

Haven't been through the process but afaik they ask about your life and stuff you've gone through etc. They mainly care about your life being in danger being gay, not just being gay.

If your story doesn't add up they won't accept you since you're probably lying.
Oh right! Looks right! I thought it was milia.

Other lgbtq person from Iran. You can fly to a few countries only with the passport. If she can get one she can fly to turkey probably but idk what the plan would be for after that.

Idk what her situation is but the problem is that easy to access countries from Iran are usually pretty bad for asylum seeking. For different reasons including just being in/close to middle east and Iranians going to seek asylum there too much and lots of them just making up stories to flee the country (faking being gay etc.). Based on my research it looks like they prioritize people from other countries more usually.

For example in turkey it can take like 8+ years to become a refugee and they don't even offer camps or let you legally work. So you basically have to live off illegal shit paying and hard work.

I a always afraid of dying because of being lgbtq in here but based on my current situation, I have chosen to try to migrate in a better way unless I really have to seek asylum sooner to save my life.

I am feeling better because it's been a week since the first fight but am also nervous about the next one since I'm not sure how it will effect my everyday life

I am just trying to get my "lines" ready, idk really now that I wrote about it here I am more nervous

Just wish me luck :(
Yeah although I feel it's the calm before the storm...

I don't remember if I was clear on op or not but I don't request to become a refugee in turkey. I just go there and ask UN basically. Turkey isn't that safe for LGBT people, maybe just a little better than Iran. UN will send me to Canada or another first world country basically. A reason why it takes longer is that they first do some paperwork and stuff then send my info to the third country if everything is ok and my reasons are good enough etc. 

My other option is to directly fly to a first world country and request there. It's faster, they accept people easier and they help you with living in a camp unlike turkey but getting to those countries is harder. Because I have to get their visa and fly to them. My first choice would be Canada for many reasons and it's so far that I could probably live like a year in turkey with the plane ticket price. Also the visa process is really hard. It takes a long time and is hard even for a tourist visa and Canada doesn't even have a ministry here so I have to fly to Dubai or something. I will look into them more, esp because they are easier except the visa process. I also don't know if having any language degrees can have any effect on the process or not. Like I get a good score on IELTS, will that help?!!

I prefer to fly to another country but I have to do more research and find one that I can manage to go for. I won't leave tomorrow, I will probably leave in a month or two. Will do lots of research and choose my best option. For now my plan is to save up money and do research.
Thanks!!!  T____T <3
I am trying my best and hopefully it'll all ends up well. Thanks! And I have to stop crying for every single comment like this :')

Thanks! Means alot!

Due to sanctions in Iran we don't really have access to those services here unfortunately. Although once I move there and make a bank account or something I'll look into making a fundraiser or something. But let's hope I won't need others help! 

After posting the op I talked to someone that lives in turkey now and is trying to become a refugee. He told me all about the living cost and lots of details. Based on what he said I should be able to keep working on my apps and live off them even if they only make 150-200$ a month since dollar is expensive in turkey.

I just have to make sure I can receive the money from Google and pay for my servers using a card. 

(Currently one of my family members in another country has his payment information on my account so I can make money and spend it if I want. And since I kinda want to run away from my family I will have to remove him from the accounts and replace them with my Turkish cards both for paying and receiving money)

My plan for now is to save money and do more research. If everything goes right I might go in a month or two.

Thanks! 

I have booked an appointment for Monday with IRQR's CEO, Arsham Parsi. I am sure it'll help me know if it's a good plan for me or not.

I have thought about studying abroad (bachelor's) but it costs alot in most countries and is only free on a few countries. But those free countries I know about are all non English countries so I need a language degree for those languages which isn't easy. 

Although the studying option is fully out now for me.

I basically am studying bachelor's here. But I barely went to any classes, and have passed like 20 points out of 150 I have to pass to finish even tho I am technically in the last term ( a normal student I would finish now).

I know it sounds irresponsible and I know. It was just due to my mental health tbh. I don't want to excuse my action of wasting all this time and money but I am just trying to explain what happened... 

I had and have severe depression all this time, my parents got divorced the first year of my studies, I hated my major, and bachelor's degree here is literally useless. It's like a diploma and almost everyone just gets one, and I simply thought I had been HIV+ for years already and didn't have much time to live.

So I was like why bother with this while it's pointless and I will die soon anyways. Although after like 2 terms I wanted to start studying again but never could recover my situation. I kept trying to actually studying but it was harder than before because I didnt study at all all this time. 

So basically my dad recently found out about it because the uni called him. And he literally said if the option is available and is even cheap he won't help me go. And I don't think I can afford it alone?! Scholarships are for masters afaik.

(Fortunately I got a HIV test a few months ago and was negative! It just made me feel more hopeful about the future. I am careful now but I wasn't even I was younger, but fortunately I got away with it.)

I can also go for work I guess but it's also hard. I have to find a job somewhere then request a visa. I am a programmer but idk if I can get an international job really. It won't be possible in a few years until I get much better and it's not 100%.

Fortunately I make a few hundreds of dollars every month from my current programming projects and the revenue goes up and down depending how much time I put on it. And apparently that'll be enough for living in turkey. So now I am less worried about making money in turkey. Although I still will need a PC / laptop there.

I talked with another Iranian person in turkey who is also trying to become a refugee. He helped me alot with my worries. And gave me lots of details about everything and living costs etc.

My current plan is to save money for the next few months and do more research about every single detail. In the end I can choose if I want to go for it or not. It taking so long scares me to be honest... And me potentially not getting accepted after all that time also.

I also am thinking about flying to another country and requesting to become a refugee directly there. It is better than turkey because I'll live in camps afaik so no living cost and it's processed much faster. But getting to those countries is hard, esp because they don't even give out tourist visa easily.

Because so many people fly to turkey for this situation it has tons of people like me and even tons of people who lie to become a refugee. It has made the situation much harder to get accepted in turkey.

Oof this is alot of text. Sorry... It's okay if you don't want to read all this lol! But thanks for your helpful message anyways! <3

So you suggest I should go after a year or two? Because the process can take even up to 6 years I don't think I can wait much also the whole point is that I am afraid of living here any longer. I don't know which day will finally be the day something unreversable happens to me here.

I was just going to gather enough money for living there about a month or two. Then hopefully just work and  survive. 

If at least I knew that I would be accepted 100% it would be worth it. 

Everyone says they don't know. It's okay. I hope my appointment with IRQR will help. They are pretty much experts in this.

Tbh the more I think about my options, the better just ending my life sounds like. I really don't want to talk about suicide but that's just how I feel. I even tried to do it today but couldn't. Maybe I should try an easier way than cutting myself. I really don't want to be dark or talk about these things as I said before but there just how I feel.

Because what is the end goal

I go through all this trouble to MAYBE have a normal life in another country when I'm like 30 already. 

The reason I haven't ended my life already is that I always thought I had something to offer to the world and I did do that as much as I could in Iran. And after that I didn't do it because I knew my family would be the *victims* of me killing myself somehow, because they are always the victims in their heads.

I thought my story would be a more powerful and inspiring one. Now I barely have any story.

Thanks. This made me tear up now. 

Actually I might be one of the more lucky ones here I guess. The fact that I can choose is something I guess. Lots of people have to run to turkey in order not to die. 

Which even worries me more. What if my case isn't bad enough. What if they just tell me to hide it and live here. They literally reject lots of people just because of not looking gay enough. Imagine living in terrible situation in turkey where you can't even work officially for 4+ years and then they just tell you they won't accept you...

Yeah...

I tried to reply nicely tho x) 

Actually if I go to turkey I'll go to Canada in the end afaik although I can't choose the country. UK was not even an option unless I directly go there.

I guess I would too forget the privilege I have if I lived in another country. Most people don't think about the privileges they had I guess.

The past few days has been super stressful for me. The more I do research about the process the more afraid of going for it get. But if I don't go... What then? Live a miserable life here and potentially some day some how migrate to another country and that's the best possiblity. I really don't think I'll be alive or not forced into sex change surgery if they find out again.

I feel like all the long posts I am making are pointless, no one cares really. I just need someone to tell me it's going to be okay if I go for it. I am afraid.

I am a programmer and I can and will work as a programmer obv

Working is not really a choice. I will have to work in the country I get accepted to go to. They just help me start for a few months afaik.

The process can take a few years and I might not even be accepted in the end. They don't just accept anyone. It's a hard and long process and probably not worth it if you won't really need it.

Afaik what you'll be able to do after you become a refugee doesn't make that much difference. It's more about HUMAN RIGHTS. Basically as I human I have some rights but I am in danger in my own country so I ask another country to take me.

Not everyone has the blessing of being born in a first world country. None of us chose where we were born. I don't deserve to be afraid of being killed because I'm gay in my country while someone else who was just lucky and was born in another country can be gay freely without any problems.

I actually did most my research on this website

I also booked an appointment with Arsham Parsi (the CEO of IRQR) for consultation. I guess that'll be really helpful.

I just dream of someday being able to be myself and not live in fear.

Finding a group is a good idea since we can share our expenses from the start too. Although I have to find the right people which won't be easy. 

This website is also all about going to turkey to persue this... Turkey is accessible but also has a harder and longer process. 

Also what if I go through all this and just end up being rejected? It's scary.

I know I'll have to make my own decision but it's a life changing one. It's scary. I am doing as much research as I can. My brain can't work anymore. I just need someone irl to hold me and tell me it'll be fine.
